issues.evidence: Problem-half UI frames (f 0:07.5 chatbot, 0:12.5 Word look-alike, 0:25 'Generating presentation', 0:42.5 Send) are flat-lit white panels with a hot centre glow vignette (measured luma 187-203); no source, no falloff, nothing in the room. They read as screen captures, not shots, beside the teal night-office stock.
issues.suggested_action: Re-stage these beats as in-world shots: corner-pin the illustrated UI onto her laptop in the blue night office (as already done at 0:50 and 0:57.5), let the screen be the key on her face, and keep pure-UI frames under ~40% screen luma.

issues.evidence: Evidence panel shots (f 1:55, 1:57.5, 2:00): left 55% of frame is an untextured flat blue slab, right column holds all information; same at 1:30-1:32.5 with a flat teal slab in the slide area and 1:07.5-1:10 teal slab.
issues.suggested_action: Reframe: crop to the evidence panel on an angled plane over a blurred set background, or fill the left with the actual memo/deck page the evidence cites; drift 3% push.

issues.evidence: Head-in-hands stock is soft (measured sharpness 7.6) and shows a black band along the top and a black pillar on frame-right (from x~875px): the plate is not filling the frame. The identical clip and framing recurs at 0:30.
issues.suggested_action: Scale the plate to fill (or replace with a higher-res take), and use a different size for the second beat (e.g. 85 mm CU on her eyes or an OTS on the screen).

issues.evidence: Resolution beat cuts to an unknown red-lit hand on a mouse (2:10) and a candle-lit warm room with an empty desk laptop (2:12.5); the protagonist and her blue night office never return, and the on-screen email now shows one attachment chip where the opening had three.
issues.suggested_action: Bookend in her space: same desk/lamp from 0:05, her hand on the trackpad, screen glow on her face, morning light creeping in; match the email to the opening (three attachments).

issues.evidence: File tree sits dead-centre in a blurred void for ~7 s (f 2:02.5-2:07.5) with captions; nothing changes in frame.
issues.suggested_action: Cut to 3 s, put the tree on the left third with a slow arc and a cursor selecting Board Memo Q3.docx.

issues.evidence: Climactic Send hesitation is a cropped white email panel on black, cursor at Send, upper-right notification; no human in the frame at the film's emotional peak.
issues.suggested_action: OTS from behind her shoulder: Send button in the screen, her hand frozen on the trackpad, shallow focus, push-in.

issues.evidence: Room-thread framing at 1:50/1:52.5 is the same crop as 1:12.5-1:15 (doc page left, thread right).
issues.suggested_action: Vary the size: wide of the whole workspace for 'Your team', then a tight insert on the Accept button.

issues.evidence: Tagline and end card are type on a near-black radial gradient.
issues.suggested_action: Put 'This time, you checked.' over the held sunrise/her face, then the logo.
